'''Harro''' was the [[Chief Maintenance Officer]] in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sent out a bulletin concerning [[Mobile|malfunctioning]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the Works, and offered a reward for anyone who could destroy the master control droid.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
